description: This file defines a React component 'DevPlan' which serves as a development plan builder and exporter within a frontend application. It includes logic for loading, editing, saving, and exporting a user's development plan, interacts with an API and database (via supabase), encodes/decodes metadata within descriptions, and renders a user interface with various controls and grouped plan items.

methods.name: encodeMetaDescription
methods.description: Encodes metadata like phase, priority, and status into the description string separated by a delimiter for storage without altering the database schema.

methods.name: decodeMetaDescription
methods.description: Decodes the description string to extract the user-visible description and metadata fields such as phase, priority, and status.
